validation.summary: All eight lines matched catalog items WidgetA, WidgetB, and GadgetX exactly. Requested totals exceed stock for every item: WidgetA 22 vs 15, WidgetB 18 vs 10, and GadgetX 9 vs 5.

vp.rationale: Reject INV-1013 (Atlas Industrial Supply, USD, 2026-01-24). Error-level findings require rejection. Catalog checks confirm WidgetA stock 15 at $250.00, WidgetB stock 10 at $500.00, and GadgetX stock 5 at $750.00, but the invoice requests 22, 18, and 9. No line price exceeds catalog (WidgetA $240–$250; WidgetB $480–$500; GadgetX $750). Subtotal $21,040.00 and tax $1,472.80 compute to $22,512.80, yet the stated total is $22,562.80 ($50.00 overstated). History has no prior runs, so there is no invoice-number conflict. The amount is over $10,000, but the errors alone fix the outcome as reject.
checklist_responses: Error findings: WidgetA 22 requested vs 15 stock, WidgetB 18 vs 10, GadgetX 9 vs 5 — all corroborated by catalog lookup; reject.
Total error: stated $22,562.80 vs computed $22,512.80 (subtotal $21,040.00 + 7% tax $1,472.80); overstated by $50.00; reject.
Currency is USD; no non-USD issue.
No price above catalog: WidgetA lines $250/$240/$250 vs $250; WidgetB $500/$480 vs $500; GadgetX all $750 vs $750.
Invoice history for INV-1013 has no prior runs; no number conflict and no evidence it is a revised invoice.
Total exceeds $10,000 ($22,512.80 computed). No separate risk signals in the case file. Errors already require reject; the high total does not change that outcome.
